units.locator: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case
units.text: 6) circumstances precluding proceedings in the administrative offence case;
units.label: Point 6 Art. 26.1

units.locator: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case
units.text: 7) other circumstances relevant to the proper resolution of the case, and the causes and conditions of commission of the administrative offence.
units.label: Point 7 Art. 26.1

units.text: Article 26.2. Evidence
units.label: Art. 26.2

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.2. Evidence
units.label: Art. 26.2

units.text: 1. Evidence in an administrative offence case is any factual information on the basis of which the judge, body or official handling the case establishes whether the event of an administrative offence occurred, the guilt of the person being held administratively liable, and other circumstances relevant to the proper resolution of the case.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 26.2

units.text: 2. Such information shall be established by the administrative offence record, other records provided for by this Code, explanations of the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are conducted, testimony of the victim and witnesses, expert opinions, other documents, readings of special technical devices and physical evidence.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 26.2

units.text: 3. Evidence in an administrative offence case, including the results of an inspection carried out in the course of state control (supervision) and municipal control, shall not be used if it was obtained in violation of law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 26.2

units.text: 4. Repealed from 1 July 2025. — Federal Law of 07.04.2025 No. 59-FZ.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 26.2

units.locator: Article 26.3. Explanations of the person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted and testimony of the victim and witnesses
units.text: Article 26.3. Explanations of the person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted and testimony of the victim and witnesses
units.label: Art. 26.3

units.locator: Article 26.3. Explanations of the person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted and testimony of the victim and witnesses
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.3. Explanations of the person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted and testimony of the victim and witnesses
units.label: Art. 26.3

units.locator: Article 26.3. Explanations of the person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted and testimony of the victim and witnesses
units.text: 1. Explanations of the person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted and testimony of the victim and witnesses are information relevant to the case provided by those persons orally or in writing.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 26.3

units.locator: Article 26.3. Explanations of the person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted and testimony of the victim and witnesses
units.text: 2. Explanations of the person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted and testimony of the victim and witnesses shall be reflected in the administrative offence record, the record of application of a measure securing proceedings in the administrative offence case, and the record of consideration of the administrative offence case; where necessary, they shall also be separately recorded and included in the case file.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 26.3

units.text: Article 26.4. Expert examination
units.label: Art. 26.4

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.4. Expert examination
units.label: Art. 26.4

units.text: 1. Where the use of specialised knowledge in science, technology, art or a craft becomes necessary during proceedings in an administrative offence case, the judge, body or official handling the case shall issue a procedural order ordering an expert examination. The order shall be binding on the experts or institutions entrusted with conducting the examination.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 26.4

units.text: 2. The order shall specify:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 26.4

units.text: 1) the grounds for ordering the expert examination;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 26.4

units.text: 2) the surname, first name and patronymic of the expert or the name of the institution where the expert examination is to be conducted;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 26.4

units.text: 3) the questions put to the expert;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 26.4

units.text: 4) the list of materials made available to the expert.
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 26.4

units.text: In addition, the order shall contain entries confirming that the expert’s rights and duties have been explained and that the expert has been warned of administrative liability for knowingly giving a false opinion.
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 26.4 · “In addition, the order shall contain entries confirming that…”

units.text: 3. The questions put to the expert and the expert’s opinion may not go beyond the expert’s specialised knowledge.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 26.4

units.text: 4. Before sending the order for execution, the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case shall acquaint the person against whom proceedings are conducted and the victim with it and explain their rights, including the right to challenge the expert, request that persons they name be engaged as experts, and put questions to be answered in the expert opinion.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 26.4

units.text: 5. The expert shall give a written opinion in their own name. The opinion may be prepared on paper or electronically, including in the form of an electronic document signed with the expert’s enhanced qualified signature in accordance with legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 26.4

units.text: The expert opinion shall state who conducted the examinations and on what grounds, describe their content, provide reasoned answers to the questions put to the expert, and set out conclusions.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 26.4 · “The expert opinion shall state who conducted the examinations…”

units.text: 6. An expert opinion shall not be binding on the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case, but disagreement with it must be reasoned.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 26.4

units.text: Article 26.5. Taking samples and specimens
units.label: Art. 26.5

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.5. Taking samples and specimens
units.label: Art. 26.5

units.text: 1. An official conducting proceedings in an administrative offence case may take handwriting specimens and samples and specimens of goods and other objects necessary for an expert examination.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 26.5

units.text: 2. Where necessary, photography, cinematography, video recording and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence shall be used when taking samples and specimens.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 26.5

units.text: 3. A record under Article 27.10 of this Code shall be drawn up when samples and specimens are taken.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 26.5

units.text: Article 26.6. Physical evidence
units.label: Art. 26.6

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.6. Physical evidence
units.label: Art. 26.6

units.text: 1. Physical evidence in an administrative offence case means the instruments used to commit an administrative offence or the objects of that offence, including instruments or objects that retain traces of it.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 26.6

units.text: 2. Where necessary, physical evidence shall be photographed or recorded by another prescribed method and included in the administrative offence case file. The existence of physical evidence shall be entered in the administrative offence record or another record provided for by this Code.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 26.6

units.text: 3. The judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case shall take the measures necessary to preserve physical evidence until the case is resolved on its merits and shall decide its disposition upon completion of consideration of the case.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 26.6

units.text: Article 26.7. Documents
units.label: Art. 26.7

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.7. Documents
units.label: Art. 26.7

units.text: 1. Documents shall be recognised as evidence if the information set out or certified in them by organisations, their associations, officials or citizens is relevant to proceedings in an administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 26.7

units.text: 2. Documents may contain information recorded in writing or in another form. Documents include photographic and cinematographic materials, sound and video recordings, information databases and data banks, and other information media.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 26.7

units.text: 3. The judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case shall take the measures necessary to preserve documents until the case is resolved on its merits and shall decide their disposition upon completion of consideration of the case.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 26.7

units.text: 4. Where documents have the characteristics specified in Article 26.6 of this Code, those documents shall constitute physical evidence.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 26.7

units.text: 5. Documents may be obtained directly from participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case, through postal or telecommunications services, including through the Internet information and telecommunications network (where the technical capability to submit and receive documents and materials by that means exists), or by another means that identifies the sender of the documents or materials and preserves them unchanged until received by the judge or body authorised to consider the case.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 26.7

units.text: If a participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case submits copies of documents, including electronically, the judge, body or official handling the case may require the originals to be submitted.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 26.7 · “If a participant in proceedings in an administrative offence…”

units.locator: Article 26.8. Readings of special technical devices
units.text: Article 26.8. Readings of special technical devices
units.label: Art. 26.8

units.locator: Article 26.8. Readings of special technical devices
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.8. Readings of special technical devices
units.label: Art. 26.8

units.locator: Article 26.8. Readings of special technical devices
units.text: 1. Special technical devices means measuring instruments approved as measuring devices in the prescribed manner, holding the relevant certificates and having undergone metrological verification.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 26.8

units.locator: Article 26.8. Readings of special technical devices
units.text: 2. Readings of special technical devices shall be reflected in the administrative offence record or the ruling in the administrative offence case issued in the circumstances provided for by parts 3 and 3.1 of Article 28.6 of this Code.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 26.8

units.locator: Article 26.9. Instructions and requests in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 26.9. Instructions and requests in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 26.9

units.locator: Article 26.9. Instructions and requests in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.9. Instructions and requests in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 26.9

units.locator: Article 26.9. Instructions and requests in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. To obtain evidence in an administrative offence case, the official conducting proceedings may send requests to territorial bodies of the relevant executive body and its subordinate institutions or to other executive bodies, or instructions to an official of the territorial body or institution to perform individual actions provided for by this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 26.9

units.locator: Article 26.9. Instructions and requests in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. An instruction or request in an administrative offence case shall be executed no later than five days from receipt.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 26.9

units.locator: Article 26.9. Instructions and requests in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. Interaction between bodies conducting proceedings in administrative offence cases and the competent authorities of foreign states and international organisations shall be carried out in accordance with the procedure provided for by legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 26.9

units.locator: Article 26.9. Instructions and requests in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. If a judge considering an administrative offence case cannot obtain evidence located in territory under another court’s jurisdiction, the judge may instruct a judge (court) of the same or a lower level to perform specified procedural actions (a judicial instruction), and shall issue a procedural order to that effect.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 26.9

units.locator: Article 26.9. Instructions and requests in an administrative offence case
units.text: The order on a judicial instruction shall briefly set out the substance of the administrative offence case under consideration and specify information about the participants in the proceedings, their places of residence or location, the circumstances to be established, and the evidence to be collected by the judge executing the judicial instruction. A copy of the order shall be sent to the court whose judge has been given the instruction no later than the next working day after it is issued.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 26.9 · “The order on a judicial instruction shall briefly set out the…”

units.locator: Article 26.9. Instructions and requests in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5. The order on a judicial instruction shall be binding on the judge to whom it is addressed and shall be executed no later than five working days from receipt of its copy, unless the order establishes another time limit.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 26.9

units.text: Article 26.10. Requisition of information
units.label: Art. 26.10

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.10. Requisition of information
units.label: Art. 26.10

units.text: 1. The judge, body or official handling an administrative offence case may issue a procedural order requisitioning information necessary to resolve the case, including information necessary to calculate the administrative fine. The requested information shall be sent within three days from receipt of the order, or immediately where the administrative offence is punishable by administrative arrest or administrative expulsion. If the information cannot be supplied, the organisation shall notify the judge, body or official that issued the order in writing within three days.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 26.10

units.text: 2 - 4. Repealed from 1 July 2025. — Federal Law of 07.04.2025 No. 59-FZ.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 26.10 · “2 - 4. Repealed from 1 July 2025. — Federal Law of 07.04.2025…”

units.text: 5. A body or official authorised to issue rulings under part 3 of Article 28.6 of this Code may, where the ground for initiating an administrative offence case provided for by point 4 of part 1 of Article 28.1 of this Code exists and the body or official lacks information about the owner (possessor) of the relevant vehicle necessary to issue a ruling, issue a procedural order requisitioning information about the owner (possessor) of that vehicle.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 26.10

units.text: Article 26.11. Assessment of evidence
units.label: Art. 26.11

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.11. Assessment of evidence
units.label: Art. 26.11

units.text: The judge, members of the collegial body or official conducting proceedings in an administrative offence case shall assess evidence according to their inner conviction based on a comprehensive, complete and objective examination of all circumstances of the case taken together. No evidence may have predetermined force.
units.label: Art. 26.11 · text
